evidence.title: GitHub - nank1ro/flutter-shadcn-ui: shadcn-ui ported in Flutter. Awesome UI components for Flutter, fully customizable.

name: Flutter ShadcnUI
summary: Flutter port of shadcn/ui with 38 shipped widgets, from accordion and dialog to table, tabs and toast.
description: shadcn/ui ported to Flutter as a customizable widget library. The README tracks a 48-item roadmap; shipped widgets include accordion, alert, breadcrumb, dialog, avatar, badge, button, calendar, card, checkbox, combobox, context menu, date picker, form, input, OTP, menubar, popover, progress, radio group, select, sheet, slider, switch, table, tabs, textarea, time picker, toast and tooltip, while carousel, command, data table, drawer and pagination are not done yet. The documentation site shows live examples of each widget, and agent skills can be installed for AI coding agents.
contains: shipped: accordion, alert, dialog, form, input, select, table, tabs, toast, tooltip
not done: carousel, command, data table, drawer, navigation menu, pagination
docs site with live component examples
installable agent skills for AI coding agents
